input: Find arts, music, theater, dance, STEM, academic and cooking summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Johnson City, Erwin, Jonesborough, Elizabethton, Greeneville and Newport, Tennessee. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Johnson City summer camps 2026 arts STEM music theater kids

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Renaissance Child camps for grades 1–6 and a high-school Applied STEM summer institute.

candidates.name: Hands On! Discovery Center
candidates.note: 2026 STEAM camps for ages 5–13 and paleontology camps for ages 6–13 at Gray Fossil Site.

candidates.name: Into the Fire
candidates.note: 2026 four-day morning art camps with themed projects and a Friday art show.

candidates.name: Johnson City Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 Princess Ballerina Camp, summer dance classes and summer music lessons.

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 camps include weekly art activities and a Langston Centre audio/video production boot camp.

candidates.name: Providence Academy
candidates.note: 2026 community-open weekly camps in fine arts, discovery and athletics, with full-day options.

candidates.name: Coalition for Kids
candidates.note: Free 2026 summer program at its Susannah Street main campus with educational and recreational activities.

candidates.name: McKinney Center
candidates.note: Play in a Week summer theater camp offered in June 2026.

candidates.name: Jonesborough Repertory Theatre
candidates.note: Youth theater summer camps documented by its 2025 summer-camp registration form.

candidates.name: Watts Dance Studio
candidates.note: 2026 summer dance classes and camp; Elizabethton has a separate summer schedule.

candidates.name: Milligan University
candidates.note: 2025 three-day nursing camp for rising juniors, seniors and graduating seniors, with hands-on skills and CPR certification.

candidates.name: Tusculum University
candidates.note: 2025 offerings included Pioneer Skills, theater and esports/business-of-video-games camps.

candidates.name: Greeneville City Schools
candidates.note: Summer Learning Camp announced for 2026, with registration opening April 20.
